summary: Bounded production implementation phase (exactly one production file changed: src/pcae/commands/push.py, matching 148D's one-file budget exactly; no PBPC/PBPA amendment; no POL-001..012 semantics changed; no approval fabricated). Implemented PBPC-001 v1.2 production consumption for both real pcae push git-push dispatch sites via a new private adapter, _evaluate_push_permission (placed in push.py, no new core module -- 148D Section 15): constructs exactly one canonical PermissionBrokerRequest (action_type=push, execution_class=mutation, requested_component=COMP-001, requested_capability=pcae_push, approval_present=False, simulation_only=True) using the unmodified canonical Foundation policy registry, and consumes the broker's decision. Invoked immediately before each of run_push()'s and _run_push_staged_file_aware()'s existing real git push dispatch calls (push.py:454, push.py:604-612 at baseline) -- the same two dispatch sites 148D re-derived, re-confirmed with zero drift both before and after implementation. ALLOW is required to continue; DENY, HUMAN_REVIEW, and any broker failure (exception or invalid result) all fail closed with zero dispatch. Verified interactively against the live, unmodified Foundation that the canonical request reaches ALLOW (POL-004 non_applicable to execution_class=mutation, per PBPA-001); approval_present remains False; simulation_only remains True (F-148C.8-1 protected by a dedicated regression test proving simulation_only=False still triggers POL-005 DENY). New 20-test suite tests/test_permission_broker_push_production_consumption.py covers canonical request shape (both paths), ALLOW dispatches exactly once (both paths), DENY/HUMAN_REVIEW/broker-exception/invalid-result all block dispatch (both paths), non-bypassability for every non-ALLOW outcome (both paths), mechanical checks still block before the broker is ever constructed, exactly-once broker evaluation (both paths), and no stale decision reuse across two logical push attempts. Updated tests/test_staged_file_aware_push.py's fixture to create an active task contract (POL-001 correctly denies a push with none -- an intentional, contract-correct behavior surfacing a pre-existing test gap, not a regression). Discovered via the actual regression suite (not static review) and repaired two pre-existing Phase 108D/109D-era invariant tests (tests/test_permission_broker_observation_verification.py, tests/test_permission_broker_verification_compatibility.py) that asserted push.py never imports the broker at all -- narrowed to exclude push.py, the one exception PBPC-001 v1.2 explicitly and exclusively authorizes; commit.py/task.py/phase.py remain asserted unwired; a new guard test (test_broker_wiring_remains_scoped_to_push_only) prevents the exception from silently expanding. HARD_BLOCK_REGISTRY re-counted directly: still 12 entries, unmodified. docs/contracts/ diff empty; permission_broker_foundation.py and permission_broker.py diffs both empty. Full combined push/Permission-Broker regression (test_permission_broker_push_production_consumption.py, test_push.py, test_staged_file_aware_push.py, test_commit_push_gate.py, test_push_phase_report_identity_137f1.py, test_permission_broker_foundation.py, test_permission_broker_policy_applicability.py, test_permission_broker_policy_composition_hardening.py, test_permission_broker_policy_rule_framework.py, test_phase_148c7_permission_broker_policy_applicability_independent_verification.py, test_phase_148c8_permission_broker_production_consumption_b1_reevaluation.py, test_permission_broker.py, test_permission_broker_cli.py, test_permission_broker_command_path_design.py, test_permission_broker_command_path_prototype.py, test_permission_broker_observation_hardening.py, test_permission_broker_observation_verification.py, test_permission_broker_verification_compatibility.py, test_post_push_canonicalization.py, test_push_state_reconciliation.py): 1016/1016 passed. Fast Green: python -m pytest -m fast_green -n auto -q: 4391 passed, 0 failed (unchanged from the 148D-reported baseline). Zero Blocking findings; one Observation (the 108D/109D invariant-test discovery above), fully resolved within this phase's own scope, not deferred to 148F. 148C-B-1 remains CLOSED; PBPC-001 remains v1.2; PBPA-001 remains v1.0, unamended; runtime remains Observed/observe/unavailable; Prompt Generation (Phase 45F) remains DEFERRED STRATEGIC OBSERVATION, untouched. See docs/PHASE_148E_PERMISSION_BROKER_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_IMPLEMENTATION.md for full detail.
